Usage: bm project add [OPTIONS] {name} [path]                                  
                                                                                
 Add a new project.                                                             
                                                                                
 Use --local to force local routing when cloud mode is enabled.                 
 Use --cloud to force cloud routing when cloud mode is disabled.                
                                                                                
 Cloud mode examples:                                                           
                                                                                
     bm project add research                           # No local sync          
                                                                                
     bm project add research --local-path ~/docs       # With local sync        
                                                                                
     bm project add research --cloud --visibility shared                        
                                                                                
     bm project add research --cloud --workspace Personal --visibility shared   
                                                                                
                                                                                
 Local mode example:                                                            
                                                                                
     bm project add research ~/Documents/research                               
                                                                                
╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    name      <str>  Name of the project [required]                         │
│      path      <str>  Path to the project directory (required for local      │
│                       mode)                                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --local-path        <str>  Local sync path for cloud mode (optional)         │
│ --workspace         <str>  Cloud workspace name, slug, type, or tenant_id    │
│                            (cloud mode only)                                 │
│ --visibility        <str>  Cloud project visibility: workspace, shared, or   │
│                            private                                           │
│ --default                  Set as default project                            │
│ --local                    Force local API routing (ignore cloud mode)       │
│ --cloud                    Force cloud API routing                           │
│ --help                     Show this message and exit.                       │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
